verdict.rationale: The pack confirms an install path exists. A community user describes a 'git-clone-and-copy install model' that 'works great solo', and the docs mention global vs vendored installs and a dev-mode symlink into `.claude/skills/`. No quickstart guide or timed first-run walkthrough is evidenced, and the dev-mode symlink is aimed at contributors rather than first-time users. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step quickstart, evidence the install takes under five minutes, verification of a first working skill, and hands-on onboarding reports.
